clients.purpose: Advanced from 9a1ebada to re-pin backend schema 6cd52f17 (PR #463: admin-configurable image/file upload size limits — ServerConfig/Channel imageMaxUploadBytes/fileMaxUploadBytes and SignedURL.contentLengthRange, enforced via a signed x-goog-content-length-range header). Frontend PR #730 replays that signed header on uploads and re-pins the additive schema; 360-operation contract re-validated against it.
